name: Wasco Berhad
overview: 今年 Wasco Berhad 没有公告新的业务扩张、合约或新业务；主要事项是两家间接全资子公司 Stellar Marketing Sdn. Bhd. 和 Jutasama Jaya Sdn. Bhd. 完成成员自愿清盘并解散。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比下滑 29.7%，净利润同比下滑 7.4%。
overview_en: In 2026, Wasco Berhad announced no new business expansion, contracts or new businesses; the main events were the completion of members' voluntary winding up and dissolution of two indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries, Stellar Marketing Sdn. Bhd. and Jutasama Jaya Sdn. Bhd. Latest quarter (30 June 2026) revenue fell 29.7% year-on-year and net profit fell 7.4% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成两家间接全资子公司的成员自愿清盘，未公告新的业务扩张或合约。
segments.note_en: Completed members' voluntary winding up of two indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries this year; no new business expansion or contracts announced.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Stellar Marketing Sdn. Bhd. 于 2026 年 7 月 27 日举行成员自愿清盘最终会议，将在向马来西亚公司委员会及官方接管人提交最终会议申报表后三个月届满时完全解散。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Stellar Marketing Sdn. Bhd. held its final meeting for members' voluntary winding up on 27 July 2026 and will be fully dissolved after three months from the lodgement of the final meeting return with the Companies Commission of…

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Jutasama Jaya Sdn. Bhd. 于 2026 年 2 月 24 日举行成员自愿清盘最终会议，将在向马来西亚公司委员会及官方接管人提交最终会议申报表后三个月届满时完全解散。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Jutasama Jaya Sdn. Bhd. held its final meeting for members' voluntary winding up on 24 February 2026 and will be fully dissolved after three months from the lodgement of the final meeting return with the Companies Commission of…
